title: Time Series Momentum
authors: Moskowitz, T. J., Ooi, Y. H., & Pedersen, L. H.
note: The single most-cited foundational paper on trend-following/time-series momentum. Directly grounds SMA(10/30) crossover.

title: A Closer Look at the Short-Term Return Reversal
authors: Da, Z., Liu, Q., & Schaumburg, E.
note: Confirms and extends Jegadeesh's original short-term reversal finding (original 1990 paper is paywalled; this is a genuinely open-access confirmation of the same effect).

title: Decomposing Short-Term Return Reversal
authors: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Staff
note: Second, independent source on the same reversal effect. NY Fed staff reports are open-access by policy.

title: Benchmarks as Limits to Arbitrage: Understanding the Low-Volatility Anomaly
authors: Baker, M., Bradley, B., & Wurgler, J.
note: Foundational paper documenting that low-volatility stocks earn better risk-adjusted returns. Grounds the regime classifier's high/low-vol distinction.

title: A Comparative Study of the MACD-Based Trading Strategies: Evidence from the US Stock Market
note: Genuinely open-access, tests MACD strategies specifically on US equities (relevant market, unlike several international-market MACD papers found during search).

title: VolTS: A Volatility-Based Trading System
note: Volatility-based trading strategy combining statistical analysis with technical indicators.

title: Algorithmic Trading Strategy Development and Optimisation
note: Uses ATR-normalized volatility bucketing and EMA trend confirmation, directly analogous to this project's regime classifier design.

title: ...and the Cross-Section of Expected Returns
authors: Harvey, C. R., Liu, Y., & Zhu, H.
note: Foundational paper on multiple-hypothesis-testing corrections in finance. This is the academic justification for research_stats.multiple_comparisons (Benjamini-Hochberg) already built in Stage 4. Grounds the project's core rigor thesis, not any single strategy.

title: New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems
source: practitioner book (cited by title/description, no free full text)
note: Original source for RSI, already cited directly in KNOWN_STRATEGIES (schema.py). Added here for corpus consistency.

title: Short Term Trading Strategies That Work
source: practitioner book (cited by title/description, no free full text)
note: Original source for RSI(2) 10/90, already cited directly in KNOWN_STRATEGIES (schema.py). Added here for corpus consistency.
